items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I used to go around and shine her boots at Carrier's Riding Academy... I used to shine Ms. Josie's boots.

ctx.x: Where Beverly's Country Club was. Right. We would stop in there. And I asked Mr. High Mills, you know, okay. We leave that and go around. On that street, right across from Beverly, they had a riding academy. Well, we had customers. And I remember Ms. Josie. I can't remember Ms. Josie. All right, boy. dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
